--Infect all script:
local plrs = game:GetService("Players")
local getPlrs = plrs:GetPlayers()

for i,v in pairs(getPlrs) do
   name = v.Name
game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").generalRemotes.infectEvent:FireServer(workspace:FindFirstChild(name))
end
